capabilities: Browse vault files and folders in two side-by-side panels
Copy, move, rename and delete files with overwrite prompts and confirmations
Preview text, images and rendered Markdown in a built-in viewer
Sort, quick-filter and lay out panel listings per panel
Bookmark folders and open Markdown or canvas files in Obsidian tabs
extras: Also installable via BRAT; README warns macOS may claim function keys and points to the clickable on-screen function-key bar.
intentEvidence: browse, copy, move, rename and preview the notes and attachments inside your vault
problem: Obsidian's file explorer is a single-panel list, so comparing folders and moving files between them requires many clicks and no quick keyboard-driven file operations.

relations.evidence: Inspired by the orthodox file managers of the DOS era.

summary: Dual-panel orthodox file manager for the vault, with keyboard-driven browsing, copying, moving, renaming and previewing of notes and attachments.
